title: Serre's Conjecture II
exact_target: Over every field of cohomological dimension at most two, must every torsor under a simply connected semisimple group have a rational point?

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, UnsolvedMath: A Curated Collection of Open Mathematics Problems, record 1468 (ALG-013). CC BY 4.0.
Diego Izquierdo and Giancarlo Lucchini Arteche, Transfer Principles for Galois Cohomology and Serre’s Conjecture II, arXiv:2308.00903v3 (2025), Conjecture 1.2 and Section 2.1, Definition 2.1.
